gloss: dominant arm; dominant hand; strong arm

definitions.gloss: dominant arm; dominant hand; preferred hand
definitions.explanation: The arm or hand that a person naturally uses more skillfully, typically for writing, throwing, and other tasks.

examples.japanese: {利|き}き{腕|うで}はどちらですか。
{利|き}き{腕|うで}を{怪我|けが}してしまった。
ピッチャーの{利|き}き{腕|うで}が{左|ひだり}か{右|みぎ}かで{打者|だしゃ}の{戦略|せんりゃく}が{変|か}わる。
examples.english: The batter's strategy changes depending on whether the pitcher is left-handed or right-handed.

notes:
Composed of {利|き}き (dominant/effective, from {利|き}く 'to be effective') + {腕|うで} (arm). Often used interchangeably with {利|き}き{手|て} (dominant hand), though {利|き}き{腕|うで} specifically refers to the arm.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {利|き}き{腕|うで}は{右|みぎ}: right-handed (dominant arm is the right)
- {利|き}き{腕|うで}は{左|ひだり}: left-handed (dominant arm is the left)
- {利|き}き{腕|うで}を{怪我|けが}する: to injure one's dominant arm

RELATED {利|き}き WORDS:
- {利|き}き{手|て}: dominant hand — the most common term for handedness
- {利|き}き{足|あし}: dominant foot/leg
- {利|き}き{目|め}: dominant eye

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {利|き}き{手|て}: dominant hand — more general and common in everyday conversation
- {右利|みぎき}き: right-handed
- {左利|ひだりき}き: left-handed
